title: Methodological Considerations in Saliva-Based Biomarker Research
author: Xu, Mumuni, et al.
materials: Saliva collection container, at least 5‐ml volume

Transferrin ELISA kit (Abcam, cat. no. ab108902) including:
10× diluent N concentrate20× wash buffer concentrateBiotinylated transferrin detector antibody100× streptavidin‐peroxidase concentrateTransferrin standardChromogen substrateStop solutionAssay plate coated with anti‐transferrin antibodySealing tape
NOTE: It is important to read the manufacturer's instructions and prepare reagents accordingly before beginning the assay.

steps.title: Prepare participant briefing and forms
steps.instruction: Create a standardized briefing that documents time of day, hormonal status, recent sleep, exercise, diet, oral hygiene, medication use, last exercise, and last menstrual period using the provided metadata collection forms; explain the collection procedure to the participant.

steps.title: Enforce pre‑collection restrictions
steps.instruction: Instruct participants to avoid eating, drinking, and oral‑hygiene activities (toothbrushing, mouthwash) for one hour before sample collection and to perform a water rinse immediately prior to saliva collection.

steps.title: Set up collection environment
steps.instruction: Provide a clean collection container, seat the participant comfortably, and have them lean forward so saliva can pool in front of the mouth.

steps.title: Collect unstimulated pooled saliva
steps.instruction: Ask the participant to allow saliva to accumulate naturally (passive drool) and to expectorate into the container until the desired volume is obtained; record the volume and calculate flow rate if needed.

steps.title: Inspect sample for blood contamination
steps.instruction: Immediately after collection, visually examine the saliva using a standardized blood‑contamination scale; if macroscopic or microscopic blood is observed, note the contamination and recollect a new sample if possible.

steps.title: Optional transferrin assay for trace blood
steps.instruction: If visual inspection may miss trace blood, decide to run a transferrin ELISA assay on the sample as described in Basic Protocol 4.

steps.title: Prepare transferrin ELISA reagents
steps.instruction: Using the Transferrin ELISA kit (Abcam, cat. no. ab108902), prepare reagents according to the manufacturer’s instructions: 10× diluent N concentrate, 20× wash buffer concentrate, biotinylated transferrin detector antibody, 100× streptavidin‑peroxidase concentrate, transferrin standard, chromogen substrate, stop solution, assay plate coated with anti‑transferrin antibody, and sealing tape.
